owner_decisions: These focused current-economy cases extend Gate 6 coverage without changing the preserved 49-case reliability corpus.
The metamod-start case proves that a real crafted Prefixes Cannot Be Changed modifier is accepted by the ordinary product path and remains mechanically distinct from a natural goal family.
The full-junk-prefix case proves that a saturated irrelevant side does not erase a reachable two-suffix salvage policy.
Both cases require compiled independent exact evaluation and 10,000 Simulator runs before they qualify.
